summary: Integrate three preflighted Luna families, preserve exact proof/source evidence, and evaluate the unchanged GLM reviewer on six blinded cases.

examined.reason: Exact Luna reversal leaf; source/guard/target/decoder review and fresh replay of all frozen obligations passed.
Exact Luna signed/unsigned high-product leaf; floor division and full product reviewed, frozen checks and replay passed.
Exact Luna extraction leaf; low-eight position/length, zero length and signed out-of-range fill reviewed, frozen checks and replay passed.
Five accepted selected forms added with exact source, patch, fresh replay and acceptance evidence; missing widths remain explicit.
Three preflighted frozen tasks with no worker repair or candidate edits; coordinator definition/fixture work reported separately.
Fresh blinded fixture evaluation with frozen packets and runner settings; all attempts and any transport interruptions kept separate from semantic verdicts.
New leaves use the original total Pure32 relation without changes to its interface or assumptions.
New catalog adapters use each original lowering directly; generic result choices, target conditions, traces and memory guarantees unchanged.
Existing program and theorem statements unchanged; extended catalog remains proved functional and prior example rechecks.
Original scalar instructions and pure/scalar execution rules unchanged; catalog additions instantiate existing extension point.
Audit file only gains new entries; no message-passing semantics, assumptions or proofs changed.
Single-thread pure leaves do not extend the computing model, memory admission, architecture naming or hardware claims.
Section inventory stays not_assessed; selected forms do not imply complete instruction sections.
Mechanical validity, source interpretation, external review and hardware evidence remain separate. Preflight work and infrastructure failures are reported explicitly.

results.method: bash scripts/check.sh; bash integration/torchlean/check.sh; all three frozen Lean acceptance drivers and exact reviewer-counterexample adjudication; stratic validate; git diff --check; public source/archive quotation scan; frozen fixture mechanical replay and coordinator semantic review.
results.environment: Pinned Lean 4.34.0 and existing pinned TorchLean dependencies; unchanged Luna/GLM runners.
results.evidence: 1482 root and 363 integration declaration audits passed with only standard Lean axioms; 22 selected forms, source/evidence/checker regressions pass. Three Luna first attempts, no feedback/candidate edits/post-dispatch checker changes, each fresh replay audits 28 definitions/theorems. Six reviewer fixtures build and audit; correct controls pass drivers and three faults reject false assertions. GLM detects all three faults but rejects one correct control; actual candidate reviews include one false rejection and one unfounded uncertainty, independently adjudicated without weakening code. Twelve recorded GLM requests for nine packets, three interruptions and exact-request retries. Known reported cost 0.027346240 USD plus unknown interrupted billing; Codex separate. Stratic valid; clean whitespace; no 24-word manual-paragraph matches in tracked/untracked intended text and archives (heuristic only). Proposal tree unchanged across final checks.
